title: Rotation and Discharge Code Builder
description: Learners write the rotation and discharge code, in letter form (CW THD) and angle form (CW 90), for eight illustrative job cards describing a centrifugal fan's outlet as seen from the drive side, with feedback and a drive-side housing outline after each submission. Free practice then lets them pick SWSI or DWDI, a rotation and a discharge angle, including the Bottom Angular Down discharge that DWDI fans do not offer.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Rotation and discharge codes for centrifugal fans
learningObjectives: The learner will apply the drive-side rotation and discharge-angle conventions to write the correct rotation and discharge code, in letter form and angle form, for a described centrifugal fan.
The learner will recognize that Bottom Angular Down (BAD) is not offered on DWDI fans.
The learner will explain why switching rotation at a fixed discharge angle mirrors the outlet left to right.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts, notices and free-practice codes announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed feedback borders pair with colour; native selects, slider and buttons; Enter submits or goes to the next card; layout stacks at narrow widths down to 320 px.

controls.label: Rotation
controls.purpose: CW or CCW for the learner's code (starts unselected)

controls.label: Discharge
controls.purpose: One of UBD, TAU, THD, TAD, DBD, BAD, BHD, BAU, or Not offered (starts unselected)

controls.label: Submit code / Retry (unscored)
controls.purpose: Scores the first submission on a card (Enter); allows one unscored retry

controls.label: Next card / Start free practice
controls.purpose: Advances to the next job card (Enter); after card 8 shows the summary and opens free practice

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Clears the score and returns to card 1

controls.label: Free practice rotation
controls.purpose: CW or CCW, default CW (unlocks after card 8)

controls.label: Angle
controls.purpose: Discharge angle 45 to 360 degrees in steps of 45, default 360 (unlocks after card 8)

rules: Outlet direction, seen from the drive side, is straight up turned through the discharge angle in the direction of rotation: clockwise for CW, counterclockwise for CCW.
UBD 360, TAU 45, THD 90, TAD 135, DBD 180, BAD 225, BHD 270, BAU 315.
DWDI fans omit BAD; a DWDI card whose only matching discharge is BAD has the answer Not offered.
assumptions: The housing outline is schematic, not a scaled drawing of a product.
limitations: Does not cover motor positions, arrangements, or product-specific catalog availability; check the current catalog for a product line.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Practice problems with immediate feedback and a drawn check after each card, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Why does CW 90 blow right but CCW 90 blow left?
Which discharge is missing from DWDI fans?
Which angles point the same way for both rotations?
commonMisconceptions: The same angle number points the same way for CW and CCW fans.
Rotation can be judged from the inlet side.
Every discharge is available on every centrifugal fan, including DWDI.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'Codes correct: n of 8'; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt.
